Key Facts (updated 19 October 2026)

  • Shalimar OneWorld is the Shalimar Group's integrated township at Village Baghamau, Gomti Nagar Extension, near Amar Shaheed Path.
  • 10 projects are on Shalimar's current project sheet: 7 apartment projects, 2 villa projects and 1 office tower (Valencia County East has two phases).
  • Units range from 1,530 sq ft (Marbella 2 BHK + Study) to 7,790 sq ft (Valencia County East Phase 2 villa) super built-up area.
  • Possession dates run from September 2026 to December 2029 and match the end of each project's RERA registration where the certificate is readable.
  • Most phases are registered by Shalimar Lakecity Pvt Ltd; Twenty One is registered by Shalimar Corp Ltd.

This guide covers only Shalimar OneWorld, the township in Gomti Nagar Extension. For the developer as a whole — its history, financial record and projects elsewhere in Lucknow and Varanasi — read our Shalimar Corp guide.

What is Shalimar OneWorld?

Shalimar OneWorld is an integrated township — homes, villas, offices, a club and open spaces planned together — at Village Baghamau, Gomti Nagar Extension, near Amar Shaheed Path. The official Shalimar OneWorld website describes it as a township on the banks of the Gomti, built around a central lake. It is built in phases, and each phase has its own UP RERA registration, so a buyer should always check the certificate of the exact phase and tower.

Who you are buying from

The UP RERA certificates show that most OneWorld phases are registered by Shalimar Lakecity Private Limited (formerly ANS Developers Private Limited), with its office at Shalimar Titanium, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar. Twenty One is registered by Shalimar Corp Ltd. Both are Shalimar Group companies — make sure your agreement and receipts are in the name on your phase's certificate.

Super built-up area vs carpet area — what you actually get

Developers usually quote prices per sq ft of super built-up area (SBUA), which includes walls and a share of lobbies, lifts and common areas. Carpet area is the floor inside your home. On this sheet, carpet area is roughly 58–75% of SBUA — for example, the Marbella 2 BHK + Study is 1,530 sq ft SBUA but 964.67 sq ft carpet (63%), while the Valencia County East villa is 6,530 sq ft SBUA and 4,846 sq ft carpet (74%). Compare projects on price per sq ft of carpet area, and make sure your agreement states the RERA carpet area.

Before you book in Shalimar OneWorld

  1. Get the full cost sheet — base price plus every other charge, GST, stamp duty and registration, in writing.
  2. Check your phase's RERA certificate — number, promoter and end date — on up-rera.in, not only in the brochure.
  3. Agreement in the right name — Shalimar Lakecity Pvt Ltd or Shalimar Corp Ltd, exactly as on the certificate.
  4. Carpet area in the agreement — as per RERA, and see the "+ S" room on the floor plan.
  5. Construction progress — the official site publishes construction updates; compare them with the RERA quarterly report before each instalment.
  6. Resale in completed phases — ask for the registered sale deed, society dues clearance and an encumbrance certificate.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Shalimar OneWorld?

Shalimar OneWorld is an integrated township at Village Baghamau, Gomti Nagar Extension, Lucknow, near Amar Shaheed Path. It is developed by the Shalimar Group; most phases are registered by Shalimar Lakecity Pvt Ltd.

Which Shalimar OneWorld projects are on sale now?

Shalimar's project sheet of August 2026 lists Pinnacle, Marbella, Twenty One, Valencia Towers 2, Valencia Tower, Valencia County East, Valencia County East Phase 2, Whispering Woods, Belvedere Suites and Shalimar Business District (offices).

What unit sizes are available in Shalimar OneWorld?

On Shalimar's August 2026 project sheet, apartments range from 1,530 sq ft super built-up area (Marbella 2 BHK + Study, 964.67 sq ft carpet) to 5,340 sq ft (Belvedere Suites 4 BHK + S). Villas in Valencia County East are 6,530 sq ft, and in Phase 2 7,790 sq ft.

How do I get the current price of a Shalimar OneWorld project?

Prices change with each sheet. Tap Invest on any project in this guide or message DSD Properties on WhatsApp for the current price, availability and the full cost sheet, which should list every charge, GST, stamp duty and registration.

Who is the developer of Shalimar OneWorld?

Shalimar OneWorld is a Shalimar Group township. Most phases are registered on UP RERA by Shalimar Lakecity Pvt Ltd (formerly ANS Developers Pvt Ltd); Twenty One is registered by Shalimar Corp Ltd. Your agreement should name the same company as your phase's RERA certificate.

Are Whispering Woods and Belvedere Suites delayed?

Both RERA registrations ran until 30 September 2026, and Shalimar's sheet also shows September 2026 possession. As of 19 October 2026 the official website still lists both as ongoing. Ask for an RERA extension letter or a completion/occupancy certificate before paying further.

What does "+ S" mean in the unit type?

The project sheet writes units like "3 BHK + S" — an additional room beyond the bedrooms. Its exact use and size are in the floor plan; ask the sales team to show it before booking.
